This is a small beans plot, only about a quarter of a hectare, so my family can manage the work ourselves without hiring ganyu labor. Beans don't need chemical fertilizer like maize does, and I don't have FISP coupons for legumes anyway, so I'll rely on some manure from our animals and the local seed I saved from last season. The rain in Dowa is usually reliable enough for beans, and I don't see the need to spend money on pesticides for such a small plot.
